title: Score-based neural ordinary differential equations for reaction-diffusions
abstract: arXiv:2611.18467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A diffusion equation can be rewritten as a transport equation driven by the score function of the evolving density. Conventional probability-flow formulations, which move particles deterministically with this score-driven velocity, typically conserve total mass. In this work, we develop a Lagrangian method for reaction-diffusion equations in which each particle carries a position and a physical weight. The characteristic ODEs incorporate source terms into the evolution of the log-density and its gradient, while particle weights track changes in mass. We combine this representation with a learned velocity field and weighted particle training to approximate these dynamics. For non-increasing reaction rates, a relative-entropy inequality supports the mass-normalized self-consistency residual as the training objective. translated_title: 基于得分函数的神经常微分方程求解反应扩散方程
translated_abstract: 扩散方程可以被改写为由演化密度的得分函数所驱动的输运方程。传统的概率流表述利用这种由得分驱动的速度确定性地移动粒子，通常保持总质量守恒。在本工作中，我们针对反应扩散方程开发了一种拉格朗日方法，其中每个粒子同时携带一个位置和一个物理权重。特征常微分方程将源项纳入对数密度及其梯度的演化之中，而粒子权重则跟踪质量的变化。我们将这种表示与学习得到的速度场以及加权粒子训练相结合，以近似这些动力学。对于非递增的反应速率，一个相对熵不等式支持将质量归一化的自洽残差作为训练目标。当增长率有界时，该目标能够控制所诱导密度的误差。该算法将时间…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带物理权重的拉格朗日式得分驱动神经常微分方程方法，让粒子通过权重追踪质量变化，并以质量归一化的自洽残差作为训练目标，从而有效求解反应扩散方程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Lagrangian score-based neural ODE method in which particles carry physical weights to track mass changes, trained with a mass-normalized self-consistency residual objective, to solve reaction-diffusion equations.
